$comment: Inputs for scripts/fetch-spots.mjs. Add an area to cover a new region. Trail difficulty is always manual: trails found by search but not listed under `trails` are written to data/trail-candidates.json for you to rate and copy here.

include.query: Boccherini's Coffee & Tea House near Gresham OR
include.notes: Downtown Gresham coffeehouse with pastries and frequent live music.

include.query: Tortillería y Tienda de León near Gresham OR
include.notes: Grocery-counter guisados, house-made tortillas and tamales.
Sprawling former poor farm with pubs, gardens and a concert lawn.

include.query: Tad's Chicken 'n Dumplins near Gresham OR
include.notes: Old-school roadhouse on the Sandy River since the 1920s.
Riverside drive-in known for soft serve sundaes; good post-Gorge stop.

include.query: Ya Hala Lebanese Cuisine near Gresham OR
include.notes: Montavilla Lebanese restaurant with an attached market.
Cart-style dim sum on 82nd; busy weekend mornings.
Big bowls of pho on NE 82nd; quick service.
New Haven–leaning pies on Hawthorne; reserve ahead.

include.query: Multnomah Falls Lodge near Gresham OR
include.notes: 1925 stone lodge at the base of the falls; pairs with the loop hike.

trails.name: Springwater Corridor (Gresham Main City Park)
trails.query: Springwater Corridor (Gresham Main City Park) Oregon
trails.notes: Flat paved rail-trail; head east toward Boring or west along Johnson Creek.

trails.name: Gresham Butte Saddle Trail
trails.notes: Steep switchbacks through second-growth forest; muddy in winter.

trails.name: Powell Butte Nature Park
trails.notes: Summit meadow with Mt. Hood views on clear days; mixed-use trails.

trails.name: Lewis and Clark State Recreation Site
trails.query: Lewis and Clark State Recreation Site Oregon
trails.notes: Short Oak Trail loop at the mouth of the Sandy River.

trails.name: Oxbow Regional Park
trails.notes: Old-growth forest along the Sandy River; Metro parking fee. No dogs.

trails.name: Mt. Talbert Nature Park
trails.notes: 4-mile loop climbing an extinct volcano; quiet on weekdays. No dogs.

trails.name: Latourell Falls Loop
trails.notes: 2.4-mile loop past upper and lower falls; first waterfall on the Historic Highway.

trails.name: Angel's Rest Trail
trails.notes: ~1,500 ft gain in 2.4 mi to an exposed bluff over the Columbia. Go early.

trails.name: Multnomah–Wahkeena Falls Loop
trails.notes: 5-mile loop with ~1,600 ft gain. Seasonal timed-entry permits may apply.

trails.name: Beacon Rock Summit Trail
trails.notes: Short but exposed switchbacks with railings; Discover Pass required (WA).

trails.name: Lower Macleay Trail to Pittock Mansion
trails.notes: Up Balch Creek past the Stone House to Pittock Mansion; about 5 mi round trip with a steady climb.

trails.name: Hoyt Arboretum
trails.notes: 12 miles of short, well-signed loops through tree collections next to Washington Park.

trails.name: Tryon Creek State Natural Area
trails.notes: Shaded canyon trails with bridges; muddy in winter. Nature center at the main entrance.

trails.name: Mt. Tabor Park
trails.notes: Short climbs to a city volcano summit with sunset views over downtown.

trails.name: Marquam Trail to Council Crest
trails.query: Marquam Nature Park Trailhead Portland OR
trails.notes: Climbs about 900 ft from Marquam Nature Park to one of the highest points in the city.

trails.name: Cooper Mountain Nature Park
trails.query: Cooper Mountain Nature Park Beaverton OR
trails.notes: Rolling oak and prairie loops with valley views; no dogs.

trails.name: Tualatin Hills Nature Park
trails.query: Tualatin Hills Nature Park Beaverton OR
trails.notes: Flat, partly paved loops through wetland forest; good for strollers.

trails.name: Lacamas Lake Regional Park
trails.query: Lacamas Lake Regional Park Camas WA
trails.notes: Lake loop with Pothole Falls and spring camas lilies; about 3.5 mi.
